prompts.wood-thin: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the edit target, an existing transparent top-down Foundry VTT door texture. Add clearly recognizable functional door handles near the RIGHT latch end, around 86% along the door. Keep the camera looking straight down at the thin top edge of an upright door: no front elevation or perspective change. Handles must project OUTSIDE the door leaf's upper and lower long edges into the transparent space so they are visibly graspable from above, not merely another latch or a mark on the surface. Add a matched pair of compact L-shaped lever handles, one on either side, each with a short perpendicular spindle and a grip running leftwards parallel to the door, with a small visible transparent gap between the grip and door edge. Make each grip around 6% of the door length, restrained and believable at battlemat scale. Preserve the original entire door, its horizontal geometry, length, thickness, grain or steel surface, rivets, left hinge and right latch. Preserve original positioning and canvas dimensions as closely as possible. Change only the added handles and their tiny mounting points. Genuine transparent background and gaps, no cast shadow on a floor, no walls, frame, text, border, or new objects. Handle material: aged dark iron with bright worn edges, matching the existing iron hinge hardware.
